description:
App to control OmniPod insulin pumps. Preinstalled on the OmniPod DASH and OmniPod 5 PDMs. If you're seeing this package you're probably on a modded PDM, so you almost certainly know what this is and it's absolutely unsafe to remove if you're actively using OmniPod.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.insulet.myblue.pdm
